summary: This is Form 8-K filed by Avis Budget Group, Inc. reporting the issuance of asset-backed securities by its subsidiary Avis Budget Rental Car Funding (AESOP) LLC. Two series of notes were issued: Series 2026-3 ($263.25M total across four classes of notes plus $13.75M in Class R notes) and Series 2026-4 ($422M total across four classes plus $22M in Class R notes), with maturities of three and five years, secured by vehicles in the domestic fleet and other assets. The Class R notes were issued to comply with U.S. risk retention rules and are held by an affiliate. This is a routine financing transaction and not a special situation event.
